$comment: 生成物，勿手改。重跑 node router/build-index.mjs。此文件把 data/ 的模板转成路由可用的元数据：gates 是硬门禁（模型不具备则换模板），softGates 可降级但必须告知，dialect 走适配器 syntax，signals 参与打分。

classes.gate: 硬门禁。模型不具备该能力时，此模板不可用，路由必须换模板，不能靠改写提示词绕过。
classes.soft: 可降级。模型不具备时模板仍可用，但必须删改对应段落，并在输出里显式声明降级了什么。不做静默降质。
classes.dialect: 方言。不涉及能力有无，只影响写法，由 adapters/*.json 的 syntax 字段承载。
classes.signal: 描述性。只参与路由打分，不产生任何门禁或降级。

description.en: Cross-cutting skeletons that almost every other template builds on: how to slice a clip into timed beats, and how to pin an identity across those beats.
description.zh: 其他模板都建在这两套骨架上：怎么把一条片子切成有时间的段落，以及怎么让同一个人贯穿这些段落。

description.en: Templates that buy believability by describing camera flaws, body wear and consumer-grade optics instead of asking for quality.
description.zh: 靠写相机缺陷、身体损耗和消费级镜头换真实感的模板，不靠堆画质词。

description.en: Ad-shaped structures where a product has to survive macro shots, hand contact and a hero frame without deforming.
description.zh: 广告型结构：产品要在微距、手部接触和英雄镜头里保持不变形。

description.en: Templates where the payload is a story beat or a line of dialogue rather than a look.
description.zh: 有效载荷是剧情节拍或一句台词，不是画面质感。

description.en: Non-photoreal looks that collapse into generic CG unless the style is specified as measurable parameters plus an exclusion list.
description.zh: 非写实风格。画风必须写成可测量参数外加一份排除清单，否则会塌回通用 CG。

description.en: Templates driven by body mechanics, beat placement or a physics set-piece rather than by scene description.
description.zh: 由身体力学、节拍落点或一个物理奇观驱动的模板，场景描述只是背景。

title.ja: タイムラインとショット脚本

description.en: Split the clip into contiguous timed segments, each carrying one shot type, one main action and its own sound line. The single most load-bearing structure in the corpus.
description.zh: 把片子切成首尾相接的时间段，每段带一个机位、一个主要动作和一行音效。整个案例库里承重最强的结构。

useWhen.en: Any clip longer than about 8 seconds, or any clip where a specific thing must happen at a specific moment. 63 of 207 cases (30%) use timed segments, and the share rises to 45% among Seedance 2.5 cases.
useWhen.zh: 长度超过 8 秒，或者某件事必须发生在某个时刻。207 条里 63 条（30%）用了时间分段，在 Seedance 2.5 案例里这个比例升到 45%。

useWhen.en: Any clip where a face, an outfit, a product or a UI layout must survive across shots. Applies to Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 alike; 2.5 additionally accepts audio and video references under the same token scheme.

useWhen.zh: 猫狗或野生动物抢镜的自拍、vlog 片段，以及靠一个真实动物行为撑起来的写实喜剧。

title.ja: クルマと乗り物のスピード映像

description.en: The machine has to stay one machine while the camera does all the work. Lock the vehicle part by part, then fill the runtime with a numbered cut list that moves the camera every second.
description.zh: 机器从头到尾得是同一台机器，出力的是镜头。先把车按部件锁住，再用编号分镜表把时长排满，每一秒换一个机位。

useWhen.en: Motorcycle and car commercials, mountain-road speed runs, chase and stunt sequences, and vehicle transformation clips.
useWhen.zh: 摩托和汽车广告、山路疾驰、追逐与特技段落，还有车辆变形类的片子。

description.en: One person, one look, a handful of places. A head-to-toe appearance lock carries the whole clip, and each scene gets one location, one gesture and one kind of light.
description.zh: 一个人、一身造型、几个地点。一段从头写到脚的外观锁撑起整条片子，每个场景只给一个地点、一个动作、一种光。

useWhen.en: Fashion campaigns, street-style lookbooks, outfit-change reels, and portrait or beauty pieces where the payload is how someone looks moving through a few settings.
useWhen.zh: 时尚广告大片、街拍 lookbook、换装短片，以及人像和美妆类写真片，有效载荷就是一个人在几个场景里的样子。

title.ja: どんでん返しコメディ

description.en: A short skit where every beat is laid down to serve one punchline. The joke has to land on something visible, and the absurdity only works when the camera and the physics stay dead serious.
description.zh: 所有节拍都为一个笑点服务的短剧。笑点得落在一个看得见的东西上，荒诞设定要配一本正经的相机和物理才立得住。

useWhen.en: Meme clips, prank and revenge skits, absurd scale gags, family comedy — anything whose payload is one laugh at the end.
useWhen.zh: 玩梗片、整蛊和复仇小剧场、荒诞比例梗、家庭喜剧，任何有效载荷就是结尾那一下笑的片子。

title.ja: ホラー・サスペンス短編

description.en: Every shot carries its own timecode and shows one visible change on a body. The dread comes from the chain — a look, veins, a bite, the next person — and the ending seals a door without settling anything.
description.zh: 每一镜都带自己的时间码，身上只发生一个看得见的变化。吓人的地方在于这些变化一环扣一环：一个眼神、浮起的血管、一口咬下去、下一个人。结尾把门关上，事情不了结。

useWhen.en: Outbreak and possession clips, corridor chases, ritual scenes — anything where the fear comes from a body changing on a clock.
useWhen.zh: 感染爆发、附身、走廊追逐、驱邪仪式，任何靠一具身体按秒变化来吓人的片子。

title.ja: 3Dカートゥーン短編

description.en: One small anthropomorphic character carries the whole film. Spell out its looks part by part, write the style as render settings you can measure, and cut the timeline so each block holds a single action goal.
description.zh: 一个拟人小角色撑起整条片子。外形逐项写死并全程复述，画风写成能测量的渲染项，时间轴切成一段一个动作目标。

useWhen.en: Pixar-flavoured animated shorts with a cute lead: animal chefs, baby dragons, clay-textured characters that still move smoothly.
useWhen.zh: 皮克斯味的动画短片，主角是个可爱角色：动物厨师、幼龙、黏土质感但运动平滑的小家伙。

title.ja: 壮大なファンタジー・SF大作

description.en: Monsters, dragons, world reveals. Each entity gets its own definition block, the shots are cut by timecode, and scale is bought with reference objects and low angles rather than words like massive.
description.zh: 怪兽、巨龙、世界观展示。每个实体单独给一个定义块，镜头按时间码切开，尺度感靠参照物和低机位换，靠 massive 这种词换不来。

useWhen.en: Kaiju attacks, dragon battles, transformation sequences, world reveals — anything whose payload is one physical spectacle at blockbuster scale.
useWhen.zh: 怪兽攻城、巨龙对战、变身序列、世界观展示，任何有效载荷是一个大片级物理奇观的片子。

title.ja: スポーツ・エクストリーム映像

description.en: The clip lives or dies on the action loop. Write every link from run-up to landing in order, name the physics you want by part, and spend the negative list on flying, hovering and teleporting.
description.zh: 这类片子全押在动作闭环上。从助跑到落地，每个环节按顺序写出来，要哪几项物理就点名哪几项，负面清单专门用来打掉飞行、悬浮和瞬移。

useWhen.en: Snowboarding, mountain biking, parkour, street basketball, water game shows and phone-shot stunt clips where a body has to obey gravity and contact.
useWhen.zh: 单板滑雪、山地骑行、跑酷、街头篮球、水上闯关，以及手机实拍风格的特技片段，身体必须服从重力和接触。
